question: (本题满分10分) 求极限 $$\lim_{n\to\infty} n^2[ (1+\frac{1}{n+1})^{n+1} - (1+\frac{1}{n})^n ]$$
standard_answer:
步骤1：将数列极限转化为函数极限并利用泰勒展开 
设函数 
$$
f(x) = \left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right)^x \quad (x>0),
$$ 
则原极限可写为 
$$
L = \lim_{n\to\infty} n^2 [f(n+1) - f(n)].
$$ 
考虑 $x\to+\infty$ 时 $f(x)$ 的渐近展开。先将 $f(x)$ 改写为 
$$
f(x) = \exp\left( x \ln\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right) \right).
$$ 
由 $\ln(1+t) = t - \frac{t^2}{2} + \frac{t^3}{3} + O(t^4)$（$t\to0$），令 $t = 1/x$，则 
$$
\ln\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right) = \frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{2x^2} + \frac{1}{3x^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^4}\right).
$$ 
于是 
$$
x \ln\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\right) = 1 - \frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{3x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right).
$$ 
因此 
$$
f(x) = \exp\left(1 - \frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{3x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right)\right)
 = e \cdot \exp\left( -\frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{3x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right) \right).
$$ 
令 $u = -\frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{3x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right)$，则当 $x\to+\infty$ 时 $u\to0$。利用 $e^u = 1 + u + \frac{u^2}{2} + O(u^3)$，先计算 $u$ 与 $u^2$ 关于 $1/x$ 的展开：
$$
u = -\frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{3x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right),
$$
$$
u^2 = \left(-\frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{3x^2}\right)^2 + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right)
 = \frac{1}{4x^2} - \frac{1}{3x^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^4}\right).
$$ 
由于我们只需要 $O(1/x^2)$ 精度（乘以 $n^2$ 后常数为所求），在 $e^u$ 的展开中只保留到 $1/x^2$ 项即可：
$$
e^u = 1 + \left(-\frac{1}{2x} + \frac{1}{3x^2}\right) + \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{4x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right)
 = 1 - \frac{1}{2x} + \left(\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{8}\right)\frac{1}{x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right)
 = 1 - \frac{1}{2x} + \frac{11}{24x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right).
$$ 
因此得到 $f(x)$ 的渐近公式：
$$
f(x) = e\left[ 1 - \frac{1}{2x} + \frac{11}{24x^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{x^3}\right) \right] \quad (x\to+\infty).
$$
步骤2：代入 $x=n$ 与 $x=n+1$ 并作差 
分别写出 $f(n)$ 和 $f(n+1)$ 的展开式（注意 $n\to\infty$ 时 $1/n\to0$）：
$$
f(n) = e\left( 1 - \frac{1}{2n} + \frac{11}{24n^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right),
$$
$$
f(n+1) = e\left( 1 - \frac{1}{2(n+1)} + \frac{11}{24(n+1)^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right).
$$ 
对 $n+1$ 的项我们也可以展开成 $1/n$ 的幂次：
$$
\frac{1}{n+1} = \frac{1}{n} \cdot \frac{1}{1+1/n} = \frac{1}{n}\left(1 - \frac{1}{n} + \frac{1}{n^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right)\right) = \frac{1}{n} - \frac{1}{n^2} + \frac{1}{n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^4}\right),
$$
$$
\frac{1}{(n+1)^2} = \frac{1}{n^2}\left(1+\frac{1}{n}\right)^{-2} = \frac{1}{n^2}\left(1 - \frac{2}{n} + \frac{3}{n^2} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right)\right) = \frac{1}{n^2} - \frac{2}{n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^4}\right).
$$ 
因此
$$
f(n+1) = e\left[ 1 - \frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{1}{n^2} + \frac{1}{n^3} \right) + \frac{11}{24}\left( \frac{1}{n^2} - \frac{2}{n^3} \right) + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right].
$$ 
合并整理：
$$
\begin{aligned}
f(n+1) &= e\left[ 1 - \frac{1}{2n} + \frac{1}{2n^2} - \frac{1}{2n^3} + \frac{11}{24n^2} - \frac{11}{12n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right] \\
 &= e\left[ 1 - \frac{1}{2n} + \left(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{11}{24}\right)\frac{1}{n^2} + \left(-\frac{1}{2} - \frac{11}{12}\right)\frac{1}{n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right] \\
 &= e\left[ 1 - \frac{1}{2n} + \frac{23}{24n^2} - \frac{17}{12n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right].
\end{aligned}
$$ 
接下来计算差值：
$$
\begin{aligned}
f(n+1) - f(n) &= e\left[ \left(1 - \frac{1}{2n} + \frac{23}{24n^2} - \frac{17}{12n^3}\right) - \left(1 - \frac{1}{2n} + \frac{11}{24n^2}\right) + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right] \\
&= e\left[ \left(\frac{23}{24} - \frac{11}{24}\right)\frac{1}{n^2} - \frac{17}{12n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right] \\
&= e\left[ \frac{12}{24n^2} - \frac{17}{12n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right] \\
&= e\left[ \frac{1}{2n^2} - \frac{17}{12n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right].
\end{aligned}
$$
步骤3：乘以 $n^2$ 并求极限 
将上述差值代入原极限表达式：
$$
\begin{aligned}
L &= \lim_{n\to\infty} n^2 \left[ f(n+1) - f(n) \right] \\
 &= \lim_{n\to\infty} n^2 \cdot e\left[ \frac{1}{2n^2} - \frac{17}{12n^3} + O\left(\frac{1}{n^3}\right) \right] \\
 &= \lim_{n\to\infty} e\left[ \frac{1}{2} - \frac{17}{12n} + O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) \right] \\
 &= e \cdot \frac{1}{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

## 最终答案 
$$
\boxed{\frac{e}{2}}
$$
